name: Nerisu Himenomiya
source:
The princess of Dreilune. Energetic and expressive to a fault, Nerisu is an outgoing young girl who loves to have fun. She’s very kind, wanting good things to happen to everyone who is good and even those who are bad. 

She really doesn’t like bad things, and highly dislikes mean people. She still thinks there’s hope for everyone involved, and looks at the brighter side when it comes to anything she comes across in general. Even so, it doesn’t stop her from disliking fiction with bad things, she would still get sad over deaths of characters, but will still acknowledge that it can’t be helped even if she doesn’t like it. 

Nerisu is romantically dense, often unaware of people who have feelings for her yet she can be quick to notice when someone has feelings for someone else. Despite her childish nature, she has a big sisterly and motherly side that shows when she takes care of someone, even if it’s unexpected for someone like her. 

She eats a lot, able to have multiple meals at once. She is childish, cowardly, egotistical and clingy. She doesn’t know that being egotistical may damage her reputation in the future, but Iori keeps warning her...
